cases.evidence: An open or unpaid checkout leaves the existing plan unchanged. Tenant-specific free quota and JodiUSA end-to-end configuration still need acceptance.
Paid matching invoice activates its plan; one invoice cannot activate a different checkout; historical checkout reconciliation passes with mocked provider events.
Commerce stock overflow is denied. Subscription feature quotas and concurrent limits remain unverified; inventory stock is not a substitute.
Caller-selected dummy/test/paypal payment providers are refused and cross-tenant products/content are rejected. All tenant paid-feature gates need browser/API acceptance.

BLOCKED: read-only preflight using the configured Jodibana test key still returns Stripe HTTP 401. Need a valid sandbox key in a secure secret location and exact isolated callback URLs. Never substitute live credentials or the dummy provider. Nine preflight safety regressions passed; these do not count as provider checkout tests.
Duplicate checkout and coin-purchase processing pass selected idempotency tests with provider mocks. Stripe rejects the configured test key (HTTP 401); real sandbox webhook delivery remains blocked.
Commerce cancellation restores stock once and repeat cancellation does not restore it twice. Subscription end-of-period cancellation and refunds are not covered.
Not run: version-matched product end-to-end test environment and safe provider sandbox remain unverified.

products.note: 60/60 shared-engine billing tests rerun successfully; nine new sandbox-preflight unit tests pass. Actual provider preflight still fails with Stripe HTTP 401.
